decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed signs, due to their compatible scale, appearance, position, and type of illumination would not dominate the front elevations of the building or harm the appearance of the street scene. The signs would not harm the living conditions of local residents, or result in conditions harmful to the free flow and safe movement of motorists and pedestrians in the area. The proposal therefore complies with policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), and ENV-B.1.4 (Advertisements) of the adopted Unitary Development Plan.

Condition : 2 - All advertisements displays, and any site used for the display of advertisements shall be maintained in a clean and tidy condition to the reasonable satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 3 - The illumination of the signs hereby permitted shall be static and shall not be intermittent.
description: Installation of halo illuminated lettering and projecting neon sign to public house.
